SELECT * FROM novel_chapter WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY chapter_num DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO novel_chapter (chapter_id, novel_id, arc_id, chapter_num, chapter_title, chapter_outline, implementation_idea, content, word_count, rhythm_tag, rhythm_intensity, plot_fingerprint, user_intent, generation_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{novelId}, #{arcId}, #{chapterNum}, #{chapterTitle}, #{chapterOutline}, #{implementationIdea}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{rhythmTag}, #{rhythmIntensity}, #{plotFingerprint}, #{userIntent}, #{generationStatus}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
